sentences.s: I am taller than my younger brother.
sentences.sCn: 我比我的弟弟要高一些。

sentences.s: The rabbit tail is shorter than monkey tail.
sentences.sCn: 兔子的尾巴比猴子的尾巴短。

sentences.s: Sports make us healthy and stronger.
sentences.sCn: 体育运动让我们健康又强壮。

sentences.s: Grandpa is older and full of wisdom.
sentences.sCn: 爷爷年纪更长，充满智慧。

sentences.s: The little baby is younger than me.
I go to school by bus every day.
sentences.sCn: 我每天乘公交车去上学。

sentences.s: Riding by bike is green and fun.
sentences.sCn: 骑自行车既环保又有趣。

sentences.s: We travel to Beijing by plane.
sentences.sCn: 我们乘飞机去北京旅行。

sentences.s: Red light means stop, green light means go.
Kind doctors take care of us in hospital.
sentences.sCn: 和蔼的医生在医院悉心照顾我们。

sentences.s: We watch cartoon movies at the cinema.
sentences.sCn: 我们在电影院看动画电影。

sentences.s: Send a postcard at the post office.
sentences.sCn: 在邮局寄出一张明信片。

sentences.s: Turn left at the green bookstore.
Turn right and walk straight ahead.
sentences.sCn: 向右转然后笔直向前走。

sentences.s: We went camping in the mountains last week.
sentences.sCn: 上周我们去山里野营了。

sentences.s: He rode a horse on the grassland.
Mum took lots of lovely pictures.
sentences.sCn: 妈妈拍了好多好看的照片。
